post.title: One ETF share, 500 companies: how ETFs work, with acorns
post.ig:
One ETF share can hold 500 companies.
US ETFs held $13.4 trillion at the end of 2025, up from $5.4 trillion in 2020 (ICI).
ETFs trade all day on an exchange; mutual funds price once a day, after the close.
In 2025, 7% of ETFs paid capital gains vs. 52% of mutual funds (State Street, an ETF provider).
Average 2025 fees: 0.14% for index stock ETFs, 0.64% for active stock mutual funds, 0.05% for index stock mutual funds (ICI).
First US ETF: January 1993.
Sources: ICI Fact Book 2026; ICI fee report, March 2026; State Street Global Advisors.
News and education, not financial advice.

An ETF is a basket of investments that trades on an exchange all day like a stock; US ETFs held $13.4 trillion at the end of 2025, up from $5.4 trillion in 2020 (ICI). In-kind swaps help explain why only 7% of ETFs paid capital gains in 2025 versus 52% of mutual funds (State Street). Average 2025 fees were 0.14% for index stock ETFs, 0.64% for active stock mutual funds and 0.05% for index stock mutual funds (ICI). News and education, not financial advice.
